seoTitle: Points, Picas, Pixels and Millimetres Converter
metaDescription: Convert pt, pica, px, mm, cm, inch and twip at any DPI, for example 12 pt in millimetres. Free and offline.
intro: Converts print and screen type sizes between points, picas, pixels, millimetres, centimetres, inches and twips at a DPI you set.
why:
Designers work in points, browsers in pixels and printers in millimetres. A 12 pt font is 4.23 mm and 16 px at 96 DPI.

Set the DPI to match your target and read all units. It uses the 1/72 inch desktop publishing point.
howTo: Set the DPI for pixel results.

faq.a: 12 points, one sixth of an inch.
The 1/72 inch point used by PostScript, PDF and CSS, not the older traditional point.
